phase: Phase 3 — Build Beautiful Websites with CSS
description: Understand relative, absolute, fixed, and sticky.
definition: Position changes how an element is placed in a layout.
rule: Relative positioning can establish a containing block for an absolute child.
tip: Fixed positioning usually anchors to the viewport; sticky follows a scroll threshold.
caution: Absolute elements leave normal flow, so reserve space when needed.
exercise: Place a small badge in the corner of a card.
